parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce crankshaft fillet bending-fatigue damage without changing fillet geometry or adding separate damping/monitoring components.
parsed.viable_reason: The proposed inertia increase lowers rather than raises the natural frequency, and the primary bending-fatigue excitation is not shown to be a resonance that this tuning would reduce; it can even increase inertial bending stresses.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: A skilled engineer facing fatigue cracking would not derive a resonant-frequency redesign from a gear-monitoring vibration technique, but the mechanism is also physically misdirected as written; it is neither an obvious extension nor a sound one.
